messages:
Marie Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock the partner program ops deliverables for next week: final scorecards, tier nominations, and MDF contingency. I put a starter allocation in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/partner-mdf-ops — please add partner-specific asks by EOD Thu.
Jasper Li: On it. I'll add the AWS marketplace line and the estimated co-marketing hours.
Priya Nair: Can we push the deadline to Friday morning? QBR deck needs one more data pull.
Marie Chen: Prefer Thu EOD so we can bake numbers into the QBR draft. If anyone absolutely needs extra time ping me @Priya.
Eliot Gomez: Adding SI integrations note — several systems integrators requested demo credits + engineer hours. How do we want to score that vs. pure MDF?
Marie Chen: Good point. Proposed scorecard: 40% pipeline influence, 30% technical enablement (eng hours / dev support), 20% co-marketing, 10% compliance/regulatory reach. Thoughts?
Omar Khan: That weighting seems OK. For hardware partners (e.g., edge appliance vendors) we should up technical enablement to 40% and drop co-marketing to 10%.
Jasper Li: I put example allocations per tier in the sheet. Quick preview here:
```
Tier A: MDF pool $150k, contingency 10%, demo credits 500, eng hours 120
Tier B: MDF pool $60k, contingency 12%, demo credits 200, eng hours 40
Tier C: MDF pool $20k, contingency 15%, demo credits 50, eng hours 8
```
Priya Nair: Love the contingency line. I suggest a policy: contingency can be repurposed for rapid retargeting if a partner underperforms by >30% of milestones. Add a clause in the ops playbook.
Marie Chen: Agreed. @SaaSBot schedule a 30m working session tomorrow 10:00-10:30 to review nominations and finalize scorecard language.
SaaSBot: Meeting scheduled: Partnerships Working Session — Tomorrow 10:00–10:30 (Link: https://meet.redwood/partners-ops). Organizer: Marie Chen.
Eliot Gomez: I'll bring the SI commitment spreadsheet. Jasper, can you bring marketplace onboarding ETA?
Jasper Li: Yes — I'll paste rollout dates and any required artifact checklists in the sheet.
Omar Khan: One more ask: hardware partner wants joint announcement cadence. We need to reserve a small MDF slice + comms credits per tier for announcement support. Put that under co-marketing.
Marie Chen: Noted — add a new column "announcement support" in the sheet. Also tagging governance: @Priya please confirm legal ok on the contingency repurpose clause.
Priya Nair: Will review and add comments in doc by 5pm. If anything blocking, I'll flag it in the thread.
Marie Chen: Thanks team. After we close the sheet I'll export a short one-pager for the QBR and the scorecard rubric. If anyone has partner-specific escalation scenarios (e.g., tier bump/downgrade cadence) drop them here. :thumbsup:
Jasper Li: Dropping a quick escalation rule suggestion — 60 days review window post-announcement before tier upgrade.
Eliot Gomez: For SIs, propose a 90-day technical milestone gate.
Marie Chen: Noted. I'll synthesize and share the final before the 10:00 session.
SaaSBot: Reminder: upload the final sheet to the QBR folder by 09:30 tomorrow to ensure slide refresh works.
Omar Khan: Thanks — I'll do a final pass on the announcement support rows tonight.
Marie Chen: Great. Closing loop — expect final doc by 09:00 tomorrow. Appreciate the quick turn.
